description: This Java class configures a Spring Boot application for a simple authentication server. It defines beans for Vert.x, server properties, authentication helpers, and health check server setup. The class is annotated with @Configuration and provides methods to instantiate and configure various components of the server.

classes.name: ApplicationConfig
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class responsible for initializing beans related to Vert.x, server properties, authentication helpers, and health check server setup.

methods.name: vertx
methods.description: Creates and returns a Vert.x instance with configured VertxOptions.

methods.name: vertxProperties
methods.description: Provides VertxProperties bean configured with @ConfigurationProperties prefix 'hono.vertx'.

methods.name: simpleAuthenticationServer
methods.description: Creates a new SimpleAuthenticationServer instance as a Spring bean with prototype scope.

methods.name: authServerFactory
methods.description: Configures an ObjectFactoryCreatingFactoryBean to produce instances of the SimpleAuthenticationServer bean.

methods.name: applicationConfigProperties
methods.description: Provides ApplicationConfigProperties bean configured with prefix 'hono.app'.

methods.name: healthCheckConfigProperties
methods.description: Provides ServerConfig bean configured with prefix 'hono.health-check'.

methods.name: amqpProperties
methods.description: Provides ServiceConfigProperties bean configured with prefix 'hono.auth.amqp'.

methods.name: serviceProperties
methods.description: Provides AuthenticationServerConfigProperties bean configured with prefix 'hono.auth.svc'.

methods.name: authTokenFactory
methods.description: Creates an AuthTokenHelper for signing tokens, with fallbacks for key path configuration.

methods.name: tokenValidator
methods.description: Creates an AuthTokenHelper for validating tokens, with fallbacks for certificate path.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Provides a MeterRegistryCustomizer to add common tags to metrics, specifically marking the service name.

methods.name: healthCheckServer
methods.description: Creates and exposes a VertxBasedHealthCheckServer as a Spring bean.
